label: Euclid/Euclid DR1/PHZ/Galaxy SED (Wide)
name: Euclid DR1 PHZ Galaxy SED - Wide
description: Euclid is a space-based survey observatory launched by the European Space Agency (ESA) in July 2023, which aims to map the large-scale structure of the Universe to better understand dark energy and dark matter. The first stage of Data Release 1 (DR1 Foundation) was released on 12 November 2026. This is the DR1 table phz_galaxy_sed_wide from the PHZ (photometric redshifts and physical parameters) products, with 846,826,349 rows, converted to HATS by IRSA.
